title: Smiling Children Posing with Scarecrow, 1972 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: Three young children pose outdoors on the grass beside a life-sized scarecrow dressed in a plaid flannel shirt, patched overalls, and a straw hat. A young boy stands on the left in a dark short-sleeved plaid shirt and shorts, a girl in the middle wears a striped t-shirt and sneakers, and an older girl stands on the right in a ruffled blouse. The setting is in front of a brick building, likely captured during a school or community fall festival in November 1972.
